formula: the sum of price times size over the sum of size
q: select vwap:size wavg price by sym from trades where date=2026.10.07

meaning: the money value of a fill
formula: price times size: the notional column holds it
q: select notional:sum notional by sym from trades where date=2026.10.07

meaning: how much of what was ordered was filled
formula: the sum of filledQty over the sum of qty, over the orders asked about
q: select fillRate:(sum filledQty)%sum qty by algo from orders where date=2026.10.07
caveat: a cancelled order counts, with nothing filled

meaning: how far an order's fills were from the price when it arrived, in basis points: positive is worse for the client
formula: for a buy, avgPx less arrivalPx; for a sell, arrivalPx less avgPx; over arrivalPx, times 10,000. Averaged over orders with a fill
q: select slipBps:avg 1e4*?[side=`buy;avgPx-arrivalPx;arrivalPx-avgPx]%arrivalPx by algo from orders where date=2026.10.07, filledQty>0
caveat: compare algos only on comparable orders: some get the harder ones

meaning: the quoted spread, in basis points of the mid
formula: ask less bid, over the mid (bid plus ask, halved), times 10,000
q: select spreadBps:avg 1e4*(ask-bid)%0.5*bid+ask by sym from quotes where date=2026.10.07
caveat: an average over quote updates, not over time: weight by how long each quote stood for a time-weighted spread

meaning: the price move after a fill, in the client's favour, in basis points of the fill price
formula: for a buy, the mid a set time after the fill less the fill price; for a sell, the fill price less that mid; over the fill price, times 10,000; averaged over the fills asked about. One minute unless the question says
q: select markoutBps:avg 1e4*?[side=`buy;later-price;price-later]%price by side from aj[`sym`time; select sym, time, side, price from trades where date=2026.10.07, sym=`NVDA; select sym, time:time-0D00:01, later:0.5*bid+ask from quotes where date=2026.10.07, sym=`NVDA]
caveat: against the fill price it includes the half-spread paid, so most are slightly negative: compare with each other, not with zero
